Every chapter rung installs the same file (a copy of the user's Slot_1: MaxUnlockedChapterName=ControlRoom, so chapter select lists all 12 chapters) and goes 게임 시작 > slot 3 > 챕터 선택 > chapter N; the chapter starts from its beginning. Chapter select changes slot 3 (the test copy); the next rung installs the file again.

Chapter select gives chapter starts only. Mid-chapter points come from the user's own Slot_2 / Slot_3 copies (ch01-mid-own, ch02-pursuit-own) and from the speedrun.com Practice Saves Collection (the rungs with "source_archive"; runs\save-sets\stray\community\set.json): Dead City before the chase, the Slums after the first objective, the Sewers start and Water Run, Midtown at Clementine's (1st / 2nd visit), the Factory (start, battery room), late Midtown and the Club, the Jail (Free B-12, courtyard 1st / 2nd half, final section), the Control Room subway and the hacking section.
Stray has no manual saves: it autosaves at checkpoints, so a few minutes of play usually rewrites slot 3; nothing else is written (settings are in GameUserSettings.ini).

Save parsing: GVAS v2, package 522, UE 4.27.2, HKSaveGame; ChapterName / MaxUnlockedChapterName / ZoneName are NameProperty values. No SteamID inside, so saves move between accounts and slots as plain file copies.

Order is story order (chapter start, then that chapter's mid-chapter rungs). Tier 1 (10 rungs, the whole story): ch01-inside-the-wall, ch02-dead-city, ch04-the-slums, ch05-rooftops, ch08-sewers-water-run, ch10-midtown, ch10-factory, ch10-nightclub, ch11-jail-courtyard-1, ending. Tier 2: the other chapter starts, the user's own mid-chapter saves, ch10-midtown-to-club and ch12-hacking-section. Tier 3: the other community points (the next checkpoint of a tier 1/2 place, or the Sewers start again through Continue).

Community saves (Practice Saves Collection, one any% run of 2022-08-02 on the launch build): same file and format as the user's saves (Slots\Slot_N\Data.sav, GVAS 2 / package 522 / 4.27.2 / HKSaveGame Version=1, same properties and trailer); only their custom-version table has 2 extra entries from the 2022 build (the 52 the installed build writes are identical). No 2022 save has been loaded on the installed build yet: the first community rung is the probe (a load failure shows as the slot card or Continue not working). Chapters 5-7 were skipped in that run, so its story flags differ from a normal playthrough.

Community gaps: no save at the Dead City chase itself (ch02-paint-can is just before it, ch02-pursuit-own just after), nothing in chapters 5-7 (Rooftops, Slums Part 2, the Dead End chase: the run skipped them), no mid-chapter point in The Flat or Antvillage, nothing at the Midtown arrest (Checkpoint_BeforeArrest is reached in no save), and the archive's 'Jail [Early Clem Jump]' / '[Early Van]' folders are empty.
